meaning:
κατα-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(καταστέλλω), [in LXX: Isa.61:3 (מַעֲטֶה)* ;]
1. a letting down, checking.
2. steadiness, quietness in demeanour.
3. LXX and NT (cf. Plut., ii, 65 D; -ίζω = vestire), a garment, dress, attire: 1Ti.2:9 (but see Ellic., in l).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not just with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive…
